prompt: Find businesses on Google Maps and send each one a short, personal WhatsApp message from my own WhatsApp. Ask at the start of each run: the area to search (e.g. Bandar Lampung), what kind of business to look for (e.g. cafes), what I am offering, and how many businesses at most (default 10, never more than 20). Search with the google-maps-scraper plugin. For each business that has a phone number, write a short, friendly message of no more than 60 words that greets the business by name and mentions my offer. Ask me before sending, showing the exact message, with Send and Skip. Send only the messages I approve, one at a time, with the whatsapp-web plugin (my personal WhatsApp, linked by QR), to the phone number with its country code. Keep it low volume and respectful: one message per business, no follow-ups, no spam, and skip businesses without a phone number. Finish with a run report: places found, messages sent, skipped and failed.
